text: At its meeting on December 4, 5, and 13, 2018, City Council directed the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, to initiate a needs assessment for additional community facilities in the Thorncliffe Park neighbourhood and the Deputy City Manager, Community and Social Services, in consultation with appropriate staff, to identify a site or sites which may be appropriate for acquisition for a new community centre in the Thorncliffe Park neighbourhood. In 2019, City Council further directed the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation to consider future facility improvements to the Jenner Jean-Marie Community Centre (CRC) and the potential for additional multi-purpose space to serve the Thorncliffe Park neighbourhood.
